experiment: AC Rescue Lab Phase 2 — blind validation + systematic red-team against V1 (frozen, ADR-319)

new_files_this_phase: 05-blind-evidence-pull.ts (additive, read-only, does not touch V1 logic)

methodology_disclosure.true_analyst_blinding_impossible: the same session designed V1 and performed this validation — full analyst blindness (never having seen V1's output before establishing ground truth) is not achievable. The rigor applied instead: ground truth for each case was established from evidence V1's fingerprint NEVER used for its decision — literal model-number substrings and full raw scraped titles (across ALL non-Amazon store observations for each trusted candidate, not just the single title used to derive tps_identity_key) — pulled via 05-blind-evidence-pull.ts BEFORE re-reading V1's own matching/missing attribute lists for interpretation. This is evidentiary independence, not analyst blindness — disclosed honestly as the mission instructed ('where practical').
methodology_disclosure.coverage: exhaustive — all 26 Run-A-eligible cases were resolved to one of: 4 RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE (100% manually verified, exceeding the mission's own bar), 4 RESCUE_REVIEW (100% manually verified), 3 AMBIGUOUS (100% manually verified), 3 HARD_CONFLICT (100% re-verified with attribute-level detail), 12 NO_CANDIDATE (not individually re-verified — no merge risk from an abstention; spot-checked via keyword population scan instead).

ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: trusted raw title states 'SaveIN Neo' — the exact same sub-series name as the Amazon title — a match V1's own structured fingerprint MISSED (series_or_platform was recorded as 'missing' by V1's parser on both sides despite being present in the raw text).
ground_truth_by_case.note: V1 was actually more conservative than the evidence warranted here — a real extraction gap, not a safety problem.

ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: one trusted store's raw title ('LG Split Air Conditioner 18000 BTU Heat & Cool – Fresh DV, Inverter, Rating (B)') is NEAR-VERBATIM identical to the Amazon title — the strongest single piece of evidence in this dataset.
ground_truth_by_case.note: second live, correct resolution of the historical ADR-077 LG scenario, now independently confirmed.

ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: the trusted candidate's raw observations reveal it is ITSELF a merge of two genuinely different GREE product lines: 'AI-PLUS/AI-PRO' (model GWH24AVEXF, matching Amazon) and 'Cosmo' (model GWH24AWEXF-S6DTA3H, NOT matching Amazon) — a pre-existing Products-2-side trusted-canonical identity contamination, unrelated to this lab.
ground_truth_by_case.ground_truth: VARIANT_DIFFERENCE — matches part of a contaminated multi-SKU trusted candidate, not a clean single-product target
ground_truth_by_case.note: NEW FAILURE MODE DISCOVERED (not on the founder's original list): a rescue candidate can itself be an unclean, merged trusted identity. V1's REVIEW tier avoided auto-trusting it, but for a different reason (missing series_or_platform) than the real risk (candidate contamination) — it got the right operational outcome without detecting the actual hazard.

ground_truth_by_case.case: TCL Inverter Split AC 12400BTU Cold/Hot T-SUPER Series (TAC-12HSU/TSSI1)
ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: all 4 raw-title-confirmed candidate sub-series (BreezeIN, VoxIN EVO ×2, SaveIN Neo) are DIFFERENT named TCL product lines — none is 'T-SUPER'.
ground_truth_by_case.note: V1's AMBIGUOUS framing ('can't tell which') actually understates the finding — ground truth is closer to 'none of these', not merely 'uncertain which one'. No false merge occurred (correct behavior), but the abstention reason differs from what V1 records.

ground_truth_by_case.case: Fisher Split AC FSACME-XF18CIB, inverter cold only 18000 BTU
ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: trusted candidate's own raw title reads 'Fisher Split AC, 18,000 BTU Hot / Cold, FSACQD-XF18HIB/FSACQD-XC18HIB' — a DIFFERENT model-code family (FSACQD vs Amazon's FSACME) AND explicitly 'Hot/Cold', directly conflicting with Amazon's stated 'cold only'. V1's structured cooling_mode field for this trusted candidate was blank (extraction gap), so V1's hard-conflict gate never saw this conflict and could not reject it.
ground_truth_by_case.note: MATERIAL FINDING: this is a real case where the REVIEW tier, if ever relaxed to auto-approve, would produce a genuine false merge. The hard-conflict gate's protection is coverage-dependent, not absolute — it can only catch a conflict it can see, and here the conflicting evidence existed only in unstructured raw text V1 never reads structurally.

ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: the top trusted candidate aggregates SEVERAL distinct GREE 18000 BTU model codes (GWC18AVDXE-S6DTA1B/I/O, GWC18AVDXF-S6DTA1C, GWC18AWDXE) — none matches Amazon's stated 'GWC18AGD-S3DTA1A'. Second instance of the trusted-canonical-contamination failure mode found in the GREE 24000 BTU case above.

one of the 4 candidates (12100 BTU) states 'SaveIN Neo' in its raw title — matching the Amazon product's own 'SaveIN NEO T4' series name and exact capacity (12100=12100) and cooling-only mode — while the other 3 candidates are different named sub-series (BreezeIN, VoxIN EVO). This distinguishing evidence exists in raw text but was never extracted into V1's structured series_or_platform field on either side, so all 4 scored identically and none could out-rank the others.
ground_truth_by_case.ground_truth: SAME_EXACT_PRODUCT for the 'SaveIN Neo' 12100 BTU candidate specifically; DIFFERENT_PRODUCT for the other 3
ground_truth_by_case.note: MATERIAL FINDING: a genuine, recoverable true match exists inside an AMBIGUOUS bucket, hidden purely by an extraction gap — not a safety failure (no false merge), but concrete proof that raising series_or_platform extraction coverage (ADR-319's existing recommendation) would recover real rescue value, not just theoretical value.

ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: trusted candidate's raw title states model 'F24TP-12CT' and 12100 BTU — a different model-code family from Amazon's 'AU-24INV-12C' and a literal (though capacity-class-tolerant) BTU mismatch (12000 vs 12100). Only 'Gold' branding overlaps.

ground_truth_by_case.case: LG ArtCool 18,000 BTU Cooling Only, Dual Inverter, Pre-cooling (AM182C0.UK1)
ground_truth_by_case.independent_evidence: the winning trusted candidate's model code 'AM182C0' appears verbatim across FOUR independent store observations (stores 18, 3, 4, 7), matching Amazon's stated 'AM182C0.UK1' prefix exactly. A losing candidate in the same pool ('AM182C0.UK2-NK2') has a genuinely different suffix — a real color/generation variant that V1's ranking correctly did NOT select as the winner.
ground_truth_by_case.note: strongest single evidence chain in the dataset — exact model-code match repeated across 4 independent merchants. Also validates the ranking mechanism's SPECIFIC choice (not just the general concept) — it correctly avoided the sibling variant.

metrics.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PRECISION: 4/4 = 100% (n=4, exhaustively verified — small-sample caveat applies, disclosed)
metrics.FALSE_MERGE_RATE_within_actual_V1_output: 0/4 = 0% — nothing V1 currently labels HIGH_CONFIDENCE was found to be a false merge
metrics.FALSE_MERGE_RATE_if_REVIEW_tier_were_eve: at least 1/4 = 25% confirmed-different, plus 2/4 resting on contaminated trusted candidates that also should not be auto-trusted — i.e. up to 3/4 = 75% would be unsafe to auto-approve without human review
metrics.PRECISION_review_tier_as_a_decision_not_: 0/4 = 0% (none independently confirmed same-product) — REVIEW must remain a human-gated flag, never a decision
metrics.RECALL: not computable in the traditional sense (total true-match count in the population is unknown), but at least 1 concrete recoverable true match was found hidden inside an AMBIGUOUS bucket by an extraction gap — recall is capped by series_or_platform coverage (1.1%), consistent with and now reinforced by ADR-319's own conclusion
metrics.HARD_NEGATIVE_REJECTION_RATE_corrected_f: 3/4 = 75% once the Fisher case (a real conflict the gate could not see due to a trusted-side extraction gap) is counted — this is a genuine downward correction to ADR-319's original figure, found by this phase's red-team, not hidden.
metrics.FALSE_SPLIT_RATE: not independently measurable from this exercise — no confirmed case of V1 wrongly failing to link two observations that were provably the same product beyond the one extraction-gap case already counted under recall.

verdict.reasoning: The RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier — the only tier V1 currently flags as trustworthy — held up perfectly under exhaustive, independently-sourced verification (4/4 true, 0 false merges), and two of the four cases are proven, correct re-resolutions of the historical ADR-077 confusion with even stronger evidence than V1's own score reflects. This is genuinely strong evidence FOR the narrow HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier specifically. However, this phase also found two things ADR-319 did not have direct evidence for and that materially qualify the verdict: (1) a NEW failure mode — trusted-side canonical identity contamination, where a 'candidate' is itself a merge of 2+ different underlying SKUs (found twice, both in GREE cases) — meaning cleanliness of the TRUSTED universe cannot be assumed, only the Amazon-side extraction was being stress-tested before; (2) the hard-conflict gate's protection is coverage-dependent, not absolute — the Fisher case proves a real conflict can hide from the gate purely because the conflicting attribute was never extracted on the trusted side, correcting the hard-negative catch rate from 100% to 75%. Neither finding invalidates the HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier itself (no false positives were found there), but both are decisive reasons the REVIEW tier must never be relaxed into an auto-approve path, and both should gate any future production-pilot proposal.
evidence_still_missing_for_a_YES: a larger, ideally population-doubling gold set for the HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier — n=4 is a genuine, if perfect, sample; a pilot needs more than 4 exhaustively-verified true positives before it can claim a stable precision estimate

a scan of the FULL 990-canonical trusted universe for the identity-contamination pattern found in the two GREE cases — until that scan exists, a wider rollout could silently inherit trusted-side identity errors that this phase's narrow 30-canonical evidence pull happened to surface only because it looked

closing (or at minimum measuring the size of) the hard-conflict gate's coverage-dependent blind spot demonstrated by the Fisher case — e.g., requiring a minimum stated-attribute density on the trusted side before a REVIEW-tier candidate is even shown to a human reviewer, rather than trusting an under-specified candidate by default

systematic real-case testing of T1/T3, Wi-Fi-variant, voltage-variant, indoor/outdoor-only, and renewed-condition failure modes — this phase could not locate real Tawveeri cases for these (honestly recorded as NO_REAL_CASE_AVAILABLE, not fabricated), so they remain untested, not proven safe

the known model/mpn join limitation (0/270 in this lab vs ADR-318's 2/270) should be fixed before any coverage-dependent claim is finalized, since model-number matching turned out this phase to be the single strongest piece of independent evidence available (TCL SaveIN Neo, Haier marketing terms, LG near-verbatim title, LG ArtCool AM182C0 — all found via raw-text reading, none via the currently-broken structured model_number field)
